offer.early: The goal bonus stops soon. Would you like to promise yourself something for the next two weeks?
offer.second: Your exams start next week. Would you like to promise yourself something for the next two weeks?
offer.late: Would you like to promise yourself something for the next two weeks?
offer.none: There is no Promise waiting for you right now. You get the offer at a fixed moment; after that you can start a Promise yourself.
offer.disabled: The Promise is not switched on yet.

form.no_squad: Without a squad your Promise has no witnesses.
form.suggestion: Suggestion based on what you actually did in the last 14 days: {days} days a week, {minutes} minutes.
form.witness_info: Your squad sees your Promise and per day whether you kept it. They don't see your minutes and points.

current.summary: You promised {days} days a week, {minutes} minutes, until {date}.
current.stopped: Promise stopped. Your squad only sees that it stopped.

reflection.title: Two weeks done
reflection.result: You kept your Promise on {met} of {target} days.
reflection.stake: Would you, for a next Promise, put in an amount that goes to a charity if you don't keep it? There is no payment function now; we're only asking.
reflection.done: Thanks. You can always make a new Promise.
reflection.renewed: Your Promise runs for two more weeks.
